# MemInjectObj

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Maps part of a memory object into another space, typically one being set up.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_INJECTOBJ (3)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err MemInjectObj(Handle kitten_space_handle, Handle mem_handle, VirtAddr dest_vaddr, size_t offset, size_t size, MemProt prot);
```

**Registers:** `(space, &args) -> r0 status`

The mapping holds its own reference, so the handle can be closed afterwards. Pass HANDLE_ANON as `mem_handle` for demand-zero memory.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kitten_space_handle` | in | Target space with PERM_CNTL. |
| `mem_handle` | in | Memory object in the caller's space, or HANDLE_ANON. |
| `dest_vaddr` | in | Page-aligned address in the target space. |
| `offset` | in | Byte offset into the object; ignored for HANDLE_ANON. |
| `size` | in | Bytes to map. |
| `prot` | in | Protection of the target mapping, never writable and executable. It also becomes the ceiling MemProtect() cannot raise in the target space. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | A handle is not live. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `kitten_space_handle` is not a space, or `mem_handle` is not memory. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | Missing PERM_CNTL on the space or PERM_MAP on the object, or `prot` needs a PERM_WRITE / PERM_EXEC the object handle lacks. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The target space has been torn down. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | Misaligned or out-of-range addresses, offset or size. |
| [`ERR_BUSY`](../errors.md#err_busy) | The target range is already mapped. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | Out of memory or page tables. |
